purpose: COADM02Y defines CARDDEMO-ADMIN-MENU-OPTIONS, the static option table of the administrator menu. It holds an option count (6, raised from 4 for the Db2 release) and a literal table of 45-byte entries (option number, 35-character display name, 8-character target program), redefined as the array CDEMO-ADMIN-OPT OCCURS 9. COADM01C uses it to build the menu lines, validate the entered option number and resolve the XCTL target program.

key_fields.name: CDEMO-ADMIN-OPT-COUNT
key_fields.meaning: Number of active admin options (VALUE 6); upper bound for option validation and menu building in COADM01C. The previous value 4 is commented out.

key_fields.name: CDEMO-ADMIN-OPTIONS-DATA
key_fields.meaning: Literal table: 1 User List (Security) COUSR00C, 2 User Add (Security) COUSR01C, 3 User Update (Security) COUSR02C, 4 User Delete (Security) COUSR03C, 5 Transaction Type List/Update (Db2) COTRTLIC, 6 Transaction Type Maintenance (Db2) COTRTUPC.

key_fields.name: CDEMO-ADMIN-OPT
key_fields.meaning: Array view (OCCURS 9) over the literal table, subscripted by the option number.

key_fields.name: CDEMO-ADMIN-OPT-NUM
key_fields.meaning: Option number shown on the admin menu line.

key_fields.name: CDEMO-ADMIN-OPT-NAME
key_fields.meaning: Option description shown on the admin menu.

key_fields.name: CDEMO-ADMIN-OPT-PGMNAME
key_fields.meaning: CICS program XCTLed to for the option; a 'DUMMY' prefix suppresses the transfer.

observations.text: The redefining array CDEMO-ADMIN-OPT OCCURS 9 (405 bytes) is larger than the 6-entry literal table it redefines (270 bytes); entries 7-9 have no defined content.
Options 5 and 6 point at Db2-based programs COTRTLIC and COTRTUPC added for the Db2 release; their availability depends on that optional module being installed (COADM01C handles PGMIDERR).
Unlike COMEN02Y there is no user-type column; access control for admin options relies entirely on the sign-on routing.
